C or U: B1 [ C or U ] a substance that is used to provide heat or power, usually by being burned
U: › [ U ] anything that keeps people's ideas or feelings active, or makes them stronger

NONE: › to supply a system with a substance that can be burned to provide heat or power
› Something that fuels a feeling or a type of behaviour increases it or makes it stronger.

example: Wood, coal, oil, petrol, and gas are all different kinds of fuel.
木材、煤炭、石油、汽油和煤氣是不同種類的燃料。
Plutonium is a fuel used to produce nuclear energy.
鈽是一種用來産生核能量的燃料。
nuclear fuel
核燃料
unleaded fuel
無鉛燃料
The new exhaust system, it is claimed, will lower fuel consumption.
據稱新的排氣裝置會降低燃料的消耗。
Reports in today's newspapers have added fuel to the controversy (= made it worse).
今天報紙上的報道給這場爭論火上澆油。
Our heating is fuelled by gas.
我們的供暖系統是燒瓦斯的。
We have a gas-fuelled heating system.
我們有一套燒瓦斯的供暖系統。
petrol/hydrogen-fuelled cars
汽油／氫燃料汽車
The rapid promotion of the director's son has itself fuelled resentment within the company.
董事的兒子升職太快了，這件事激起了公司內的不滿情緒。
The president's speech fuelled speculation that she is about to resign.
總統的講話引起了人們認為她準備辭職的猜測。

NONE: › a device that changes the chemical energy from a fuel into electricity

example: Car manufacturers are looking at alternative sources of energy such as hydrogen fuel cells.
汽車製造商們正在尋找其他能源例如氫燃料電池。

NONE: › a system in a vehicle that directs an exact amount of fuel into the engine when it is needed
› UK the condition of having too little money to be able to keep your home warm
（因為缺錢而無法給住房取暖的）能源貧困狀況

example: Rising gas costs have pushed more families into fuel poverty.
瓦斯價格的上漲把更多的家庭逼到了能源貧困狀況。

NONE: › a part of a device that produces nuclear power
› working in a way that does not waste fuel

example: They are replacing their old aircraft with more fuel-efficient models.
他們正在用更高效使用燃料的飛機型號取代舊飛機。

NONE: › not having enough money to heat your home, because of a low income or high energy prices
（因為能源價格高昂而沒有足夠的錢來給住房取暖）能源貧困的

example: Extra funding would be targeted on fuel-poor households.
對能源貧困的家庭將提供專門性的額外資助。
